fields.meta_title: Wedding Guest Survey Builder for Couples and Pros | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a wedding guest survey from a prompt: travel plans, dietary needs, song requests, and feedback after the day. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Wedding Guest Survey to Send Before and After the Vows
fields.hero_description: Build a wedding guest survey that collects travel plans, dietary needs, and song requests, saved to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: Every Guest's Answers, Ready for Your Vendors
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds the wedding guest survey from your prompt, along with the reminders that follow up on late answers.
fields.feature_1:
Questions drafted from the wedding plan

Describe the weekend, the menu, and who is invited. Emergent drafts the questions, and a follow-up prompt rewrites one on the day the caterer swaps out a dinner course.
fields.feature_2:
Every answer on the guest's own row

Each guest's answers save to a database you own, one row per guest. Filter by event or by table, and hand the caterer a list that already lines up with the seating chart.
fields.feature_3:
Reminders for guests yet to answer

Pick a reminder date, such as 10 days after the survey goes out. The app emails every guest still missing an answer, and sends you an alert once the last reply comes in.
fields.feature_4:
One question per screen on a phone

Guests answer one question per screen on a phone, at an airport gate or on the couch at home. Emergent puts no cap on responses, whether 40 guests answer the survey or 300.
fields.feature_5:
Guest list synced from where you keep it

Connect the spreadsheet or planning app that holds your guest list through its API. The app syncs names and email addresses in, and sends each finished answer back to the list.
fields.feature_6:
Hosted on your wedding website's domain

Custom domains are included in Emergent and use credits. Put the survey on the one your wedding website already uses. Guests then open a link with a name they recognize.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Surveys Sent to Wedding Guests
fields.tab_content_1:
46 guests flying in Friday asked for a shuttle

Lucienne and Arvo invited 140 guests to their wedding weekend. The survey asked which events each guest would attend and who needed the airport shuttle. Of the 140 guests, 118 answered: 92 will be at the Friday welcome dinner, and 46 need the Friday shuttle. The app emailed planner Hettie Bellcote the list.
fields.tab_content_2:
Each of 17 dietary needs tagged to its table

Ravensmoor Catering sends a dietary survey to the guests of every wedding it serves, with a pick list in place of a blank box. For one wedding, 81 of the 96 guests answered and 17 named a need, 4 of them tree nut allergies. The app emailed head chef Lisandro Wynter all 17 names with their table numbers.
fields.tab_content_3:
24 guests asked for songs from the 1980s

DJ Arlo Brisco sends each couple's guests 2 questions on a phone, one per screen: a song that gets them dancing, and the decade it is from. At one 90-guest wedding, 64 guests answered. The 1980s led with 24 picks and the 1990s came next with 17. Arlo opened the dancing with a 1980s block.
fields.tab_content_4:
Guests gave parking a 3.1, the lowest score

Wrenhollow Barn emails guests a 4-question survey on the Monday after each wedding, with every question scored out of 5. Across 6 weddings in June, 212 guests answered. The ceremony lawn scored 4.7, and parking scored 3.1, the lowest of the 4. For July, the barn added another attendant to the parking field.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Wedding Guest Survey
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a wedding guest survey that gets every guest's plans and dietary needs in before your vendors need them.
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Give dietary needs a pick list
fields.howto_step_1_des: Settle first which events the survey covers, such as a welcome dinner and a brunch the morning after. Name them in your prompt. Each guest then answers only for the events on their invitation and never sees a dinner they were not asked to.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask where each guest is coming from before anything about flights or hotels. Show the arrival day and shuttle questions only to guests who are flying in. A guest who lives 20 minutes away skips them and finishes sooner.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Offer a pick list of needs and allergies with an Other box, in place of one blank text field. A typed answer like no nuts please is hard to count. A picked option goes straight onto the caterer's list with the guest's table.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Guests open the link on a phone, in a spare minute. Give each question its own screen with large buttons, and keep the whole survey short enough to finish in one sitting, such as 6 to 8 questions for the weekend.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Tag answers with table and party
fields.howto_step_5_des: Save each answer on the guest's row, with their table number and the name of their party. When one guest answers for a couple, the caterer still counts 2 meals, and the planner sees both names on the shuttle list.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Set the reminder and close dates
fields.howto_step_6_des: Pick a reminder date and a close date that falls before your caterer's final count is due. Put both in your prompt. The app emails guests who have not answered on the reminder date, and the lists you send stop changing at close.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Send a short survey after the wedding
fields.howto_step_7_des: A few days after the wedding, send 4 questions on the parts guests saw: the ceremony site, the food, the dancing, and parking. A venue or planner who asks the same 4 every time can compare one wedding with the next.

faq_plan.q: What is a wedding guest survey?
faq_plan.a: A wedding guest survey is a short questionnaire sent to the people invited to a wedding. Sent before the day, it collects their plans: which events they will attend, how they are traveling, and what they can eat. Sent after it, it asks guests to score the parts of the day they saw.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a wedding guest survey?
faq_plan.a: Describe the wedding in Emergent's AI survey builder: the events and what each vendor needs back from guests. Emergent builds the questions, the rules that decide who sees which one, and the table that holds every answer. When the plans change, edit a question with a follow-up prompt.

faq_plan.q: What questions should I ask on a wedding guest survey?
faq_plan.a: Ask only what someone will act on. Before the wedding, that means the events each guest will attend, their arrival day, any dietary need, and a song request; leave the yes or no on attending to the invitation reply. After the wedding, ask how the day went for them and what they would change.

faq_plan.q: Can a planner reuse one wedding guest survey for every couple?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Build it once, then prompt Emergent to swap in each couple's names and date, and keep each wedding's answers in its own table. There is no response cap in Emergent, however many weddings a season holds. A planning firm can build an IT survey for its own office staff the same way.

faq_plan.q: How should a wedding guest survey ask about food allergies?
faq_plan.a: With a pick list, not a blank box. Under federal law, the major food allergens are milk, egg, fish, Crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, wheat, peanuts, soybeans, and sesame, which makes a sound starting list. Add vegetarian, vegan, and an Other box. Then ask whether each need is an allergy or a preference, and pass that answer to the caterer with the guest's name.

faq_plan.q: When should a couple send their wedding guest survey?
faq_plan.a: Send it with the invitations or soon after, and close it a week or two before the caterer needs a final headcount. That leaves room for one reminder, and for calling the last few guests yourself. A survey sent the week of the wedding arrives after the vendors have locked their numbers.

faq_plan.q: What should a wedding guest survey ask after the wedding?
faq_plan.a: Ask about the guest's own day, not the couple's choices: how getting there went, how the food was, and one moment they remember. Keep it to 4 questions and send it within a few days, as you would a post purchase survey, while the day is still fresh. Couples can add an open box for messages to them.

faq_plan.q: Should a wedding guest survey be anonymous?
faq_plan.a: Before the wedding, no: the caterer needs a name and a table for every dietary need, and the planner needs names for the shuttle. After the wedding, leave names off the scored questions if you want guests to be frank about the food or the venue. Keep a separate, named box for notes to the couple.

faq_plan.q: How do I remind guests to finish the wedding guest survey?
faq_plan.a: Set a reminder date in your prompt, and the app emails every guest who has not answered on that date. Add a second reminder a few days before the survey closes. Emergent builds the reminder emails from the same prompt as the survey. The list of guests still missing stays current as answers come in.

faq_plan.q: Can a wedding guest survey collect mailing addresses for thank-you cards?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Add an address question near the end, with separate fields for street, city, state, and ZIP code. Split fields print cleanly on envelopes. Each address saves to a database you own, on the same row as the guest's other answers. Ask for it the way an alumni survey keeps a mailing list current: once, with a box to confirm it.

plan.angle: The SERP for this query is wedding-planning trivia (budgets, guest counts, etiquette), and no result hands the searcher a survey to send. This page is the survey, shown through the four people who send one: the couple planning a destination weekend, the caterer collecting dietary needs, the DJ collecting song picks, and the venue asking guests what to fix after each wedding. Every tab ends in a list someone acts on. The FAQ covers what to ask, when to send it, a dietary pick list built on the FDA's major allergens, anonymity, reminders, phones, planners reusing one survey, the questions to ask after the wedding and collecting mailing addresses. Attendance and headcount belong to the wedding RSVP form page.
